 Order
This is first bail application filed on behalf of the applicant under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.

2. The applicant is in custody since 21.06.2025 in connection with Crime No.206 of 2025 registered at P.S.- Audyogik Kshetra Satlapur, District-Raisen (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 376(3), 376(2)(n), 376(2)(f), 323 of the Indian Penal Code and under Section 5(m), 5(l), 6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 3. Prosecution story, in brief, is that applicant repeatedly committed aggravated penetrative sexual assault on minor prosecutrix.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is in jail since 21.06.2025 and he has falsely been implicated in this case.

Prosecutrix in her statement recorded under Section 183 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 has not made any allegations with respect to sexual NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:50751 2 MCRC-41318-2025 intercourse.
DNA report does not support the prosecution story.
The statement of the prosecutrix before the trial Court has also been recorded, in which, she has not made any allegations against the applicant.

sentences.text: The trial of the case will take considerable time.
Therefore, it has been prayed that the applicant be released on bail pending the trial.
5. On the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed grant of bail.
6. Having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case, I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.
Consequently, first bail application under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

7. It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.15,000/- (Rupees Fifteen Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.
He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
8. This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
9. Soft copy of this bail order immediately/forthwith be sent to applicant through concerned Jail Superintendent.
